extDescription.message: Peek before you trust. Flags sites exposed to PHP2Shell and guards your seed phrase, wallet signatures and clipboard. Zero data collected.

noData.message: Nothing to peek at yet. Reload the page.

notPhp.message: No PHP in sight. Nothing to worry about here.

vulnNote.message: This site advertises a PHP version older than the fix. Don't type passwords, card details or connect your wallet here until it's patched. Some Linux distros patch without bumping the version, so this is a strong hint, not proof.

eolTitle.message: Out of support: no PHP2Shell fix

eolNote.message: This site runs a PHP branch that never got an official fix. Treat it as exposed: no passwords, cards or wallet connections.

hiddenTitle.message: Runs PHP, keeps its version secret

hiddenNote.message: Can't tell from the outside. That's normal — and smart security.

footer.message: 100% local. No requests, no tracking, no data. Only checks the tab you're on; never scans or lists sites. Open source.
